question: Kapila is thrice as efficient as Vipul and together they can finish a piece of work in 30 days. In how many days Vipul alone can finish the work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of efficiencies of Kapila and Vipul = 3 : 1

Total combined efficiency = 3 + 1 = 4 units/day

Total work = Combined efficiency × Days taken together = 4 × 30 = 120 units

Time taken by Vipul alone = Total work ÷ Vipul's efficiency = 120 ÷ 1 = 120 days

**∴ The correct answer is 120 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Kapila is thrice as efficient as Vipul.

Time taken by both working together to complete the work = 30 days.

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the efficiency of Vipul be 1 unit/day.

⇒ Kapila is thrice as efficient, so Kapila's efficiency = 3 × 1 = 3 units/day.

⇒ Total efficiency of Kapila and Vipul working together = 3 + 1 = 4 units/day.

⇒ Total Work = Total Efficiency × Time taken together = 4 × 30 = 120 units.

⇒ Time taken by Vipul alone = Total Work ÷ Vipul's efficiency

⇒ Time taken by Vipul alone = 120 ÷ 1 = 120 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 120 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time. If A is n times as efficient as B, then A will take 1/n of the time taken by B to complete the same work.

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the total work done by the individuals. If all persons work for the same number of days, their wages are distributed in the direct ratio of their efficiencies.

Pipes & Cisterns

This topic works on the exact same logic as Time & Work. An inlet pipe has positive efficiency (filling), whereas an outlet pipe has negative efficiency (emptying).
